name: Aisha bint Abi Bakr
biography: Wife of the Prophet and one of the most prolific scholars and narrators among the Companions.

name: Urwah ibn al-Zubayr
biography: One of the Seven Fuqaha of Medina; prominent jurist and scholar of early Islamic history and Maghazi.

name: Ibn Shihab al-Zuhri
biography: Pivotal authority in hadith transmission and codification; teacher of Malik, al-Layth, and Uqayl.

name: Uqayl ibn Khalid
biography: Thiqah transmitter from Ayla who studied closely under al-Zuhri; relied upon by al-Bukhari and Muslim.

name: Al-Layth ibn Sa'd
biography: Eminent jurist and chief scholar of Egypt; praised by al-Shafi'i for immense knowledge and reliability.

name: Yahya ibn Bukayr
biography: Prominent Egyptian hadith transmitter and key teacher of Imam al-Bukhari in his Sahih.

name: Yunus ibn Yazid
biography: Major transmitter from al-Zuhri; relied upon by Imam Muslim in his Sahih.

name: Abd Allah ibn Wahb
biography: Prominent Egyptian jurist and hadith master; author of al-Muwatta al-Saghir and Jami'.

name: Abu al-Tahir ibn Sarh
biography: Thiqah hadith master of Egypt and one of the principal teachers of Imam Muslim.

name: Harmala ibn Yahya
biography: Companion of al-Shafi'i and reliable transmitter relied upon by Imam Muslim.

name: Jabir ibn Abd Allah
biography: Prominent Ansari Companion present at the Pledge of Aqaba; one of the prolific narrators of Hadith.

name: Abu Salama ibn Abd al-Rahman
biography: One of the eminent jurists of Medina and son of the Companion Abd al-Rahman ibn Awf.

name: Ali ibn Abi Talib
biography: Cousin and son-in-law of the Prophet, fourth righteous Caliph, first Shia Imam, and eyewitness at Hira.

name: Al-Sharif al-Radi
biography: Renowned scholar, poet, and compiler of Nahj al-Balagha.

name: Ja'far al-Sadiq
biography: Sixth Imam of the Ahl al-Bayt; foundational authority on Islamic jurisprudence, theology, and ethics.

name: Zurarah ibn A'yan
biography: Chief disciple of Imam al-Baqir and Imam al-Sadiq; among the foremost jurists of the Ashab al-Ijma.

name: Hisham ibn Salim
biography: Trusted companion and narrator from Imam al-Sadiq and Imam al-Kazim.

name: Muhammad ibn Abi Umayr
biography: Celebrated Imami hadith authority; one of the consensus transmitters whose marasil are accepted as musnad.

name: Ibrahim ibn Hashim
biography: Pioneer who transmitted Kufan hadith traditions to the seminary of Qom; highly trusted narrator.

name: Ali ibn Ibrahim
biography: Eminent Imami hadith scholar, author of Tafsir al-Qummi, and principal teacher of al-Kulayni.
